title: Anicca (2)
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Rādho Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Aniccadhammo aniccadhammo ti bhante vuccati || || Katamo nu kho bhante aniccadhammo ti || || 4 Rūpaṃ kho Rādha aniccadhammo || vedanā aniccadhammo [page 196] 196 RĀDHA-SAṂYUTTA [XXIII. 14. 5 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] || saññā || saṅkharā aniccadhammo || viññāṇam aniccadhammo || || 5 Evam passam || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
